name: CHAPTERS Group AG
summary: CHAPTERS Group AG, together with its subsidiaries, provides various software solutions. It also provides electronic gate and door systems, as well as barriers, fire, and smoke protection systems, as well as engages in the field of refrigeration and air conditioning technology, and air purification.
